```text
   129→          className={`${styles.fileDelete} ${styles.semanticClassNames.fileDelete}`}
   130→          onClick={(e) => {
   131→            e.stopPropagation()
   132→            onDelete()
   133→          }}
   134→          aria-label={`Delete ${file.filename}`}
   135→        >
   136→          <Trash2 size={12} />
   137→        </button>
   138→      )}
   139→    </div>
   140→  )
   141→}
   142→
   143→// ─── Main modal ─────────────────────────────────────────
   144→export const CodeEditorModal: FC<CodeEditorModalProps> = ({
   145→  files: initialFiles,
   146→  onFilesChange,
   147→  dismiss,
   148→  colorScheme,
   149→}) => {
   150→  const [editFiles, setEditFiles] = useState<CodeFile[]>(() =>
   151→    initialFiles.map((f) => ({ ...f })),
   152→  )
   153→  const [activeFilename, setActiveFilename] = useState(
   154→    initialFiles[0]?.filename ?? '',
   155→  )
   156→
   157→  const [editingFilename, setEditingFilename] = useState<string | null>(null)
   158→  const [newFilenameInput, setNewFilenameInput] = useState('')
   159→  const [dragActiveId, setDragActiveId] = useState<string | null>(null)
   160→
   161→  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
   162→  const editorRef = useRef<EditorView | null>(null)
   163→  const languageCompartmentRef = useRef<Compartment>(null!)
   164→  const themeCompartmentRef = useRef<Compartment>(null!)
   165→  if (!languageCompartmentRef.current)
   166→    languageCompartmentRef.current = new Compartment()
   167→  if (!themeCompartmentRef.current)
   168→    themeCompartmentRef.current = new Compartment()
   169→
   170→  const onCodeChangeRef = useRef<(code: string) => void>(undefined)
   171→  const editFilesRef = useRef(editFiles)
   172→  editFilesRef.current = editFiles
   173→
   174→  const activeFile =
   175→    editFiles.find((f) => f.filename === activeFilename) ?? editFiles[0]
   176→
   177→  onCodeChangeRef.current = (code: string) => {
   178→    setEditFiles((prev) =>
   179→      prev.map((f) => (f.filename === activeFilename ? { ...f, code } : f)),
   180→    )
   181→  }
   182→
   183→  // Recreate editor when switching files
   184→  useEffect(() => {
   185→    const container = containerRef.current
   186→    if (!container) return
   187→
   188→    const file = editFilesRef.current.find((f) => f.filename === activeFilename)
   189→    if (!file) return
   190→
   191→    let cancelled = false
   192→
   193→    const lang = normalizeLanguage(
   194→      file.language ?? getLanguageFromFilename(file.filename),
   195→    )
   196→
   197→    const editor = new EditorView({
   198→      parent: container,
   199→      state: EditorState.create({
   200→        doc: file.code,
   201→        extensions: [
   202→          history(),
   203→          keymap.of([...defaultKeymap, ...historyKeymap, indentWithTab]),
   204→          EditorView.updateListener.of((update) => {
   205→            if (!update.docChanged) return
   206→            onCodeChangeRef.current?.(update.state.doc.toString())
   207→          }),
   208→          lineNumbers(),
   209→          themeCompartmentRef.current.of(getThemeExtensions(colorScheme)),
   210→          languageCompartmentRef.current.of([]),
   211→        ],
   212→      }),
   213→    })
   214→
   215→    editorRef.current = editor
   216→    ;(async () => {
   217→      const extension = await loadLanguageExtension(lang)
   218→      if (cancelled) return
   219→      editor.dispatch({
   220→        effects: languageCompartmentRef.current.reconfigure(extension),
   221→      })
   222→    })()
   223→
   224→    return () => {
   225→      cancelled = true
   226→      editor.destroy()
   227→      editorRef.current = null
   228→    }
   229→  }, [activeFilename]) // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
   230→
   231→  // Sync theme when colorScheme changes
   232→  useEffect(() => {
   233→    const editor = editorRef.current
   234→    if (!editor) return
   235→    editor.dispatch({
   236→      effects: themeCompartmentRef.current.reconfigure(
   237→        getThemeExtensions(colorScheme),
   238→      ),
   239→    })
   240→  }, [colorScheme])
   241→
   242→  const handleDismiss = useCallback(() => {
   243→    onFilesChange?.(editFiles)
   244→    dismiss()
   245→  }, [editFiles, onFilesChange, dismiss])
   246→
   247→  const handleAddFile = useCallback(() => {
   248→    const name = `untitled-${editFiles.length + 1}.ts`
   249→    const newFile: CodeFile = {
   250→      filename: name,
   251→      code: '',
   252→      language: 'typescript',
   253→    }
   254→    setEditFiles((prev) => [...prev, newFile])
   255→    setActiveFilename(name)
   256→  }, [editFiles.length])
   257→
   258→  const handleDeleteFile = useCallback(
   259→    (filename: string) => {
   260→      if (editFiles.length <= 1) return
   261→      const newFiles = editFiles.filter((f) => f.filename !== filename)
   262→      setEditFiles(newFiles)
   263→      if (activeFilename === filename) {
   264→        setActiveFilename(newFiles[0]?.filename ?? '')
   265→      }
   266→    },
   267→    [editFiles, activeFilename],
   268→  )
   269→
   270→  const handleRenameFile = useCallback(
   271→    (oldName: string, newName: string) => {
   272→      if (
   273→        !newName.trim() ||
   274→        editFiles.some((f) => f.filename === newName && f.filename !== oldName)
   275→      ) {
   276→        setEditingFilename(null)
   277→        return
   278→      }
   279→      setEditFiles((prev) =>
   280→        prev.map((f) =>
   281→          f.filename === oldName
   282→            ? { ...f, filename: newName, language: undefined }
   283→            : f,
   284→        ),
   285→      )
   286→      if (activeFilename === oldName) {
   287→        setActiveFilename(newName)
   288→      }
   289→      setEditingFilename(null)
   290→    },
   291→    [editFiles, activeFilename],
   292→  )
   293→
   294→  // DnD
   295→  const sensors = useSensors(
   296→    useSensor(PointerSensor, { activationConstraint: { distance: 5 } }),
   297→  )
   298→
   299→  const fileIds = useMemo(() => editFiles.map((f) => f.filename), [editFiles])
   300→
   301→  const handleDragEnd = useCallback(
   302→    (event: DragEndEvent) => {
   303→      const { active, over } = event
   304→      setDragActiveId(null)
   305→      if (!over || active.id === over.id) return
   306→
   307→      const oldIndex = editFiles.findIndex((f) => f.filename === active.id)
   308→      const newIndex = editFiles.findIndex((f) => f.filename === over.id)
   309→      if (oldIndex === -1 || newIndex === -1) return
   310→
   311→      setEditFiles(arrayMove(editFiles, oldIndex, newIndex))
   312→    },
   313→    [editFiles],
   314→  )
   315→
   316→  const dragActiveFile = dragActiveId
   317→    ? editFiles.find((f) => f.filename === dragActiveId)
   318→    : null
   319→
   320→  const { className: portalThemeClassName } = usePortalTheme()
   321→
   322→  const language = activeFile
   323→    ? (activeFile.language ?? getLanguageFromFilename(activeFile.filename))
   324→    : ''
   325→
   326→  return (
   327→    <div className={`${styles.modal} ${styles.semanticClassNames.modal}`}>
   328→      {/* Title bar */}
   329→      <div
   330→        className={`${styles.modalTitlebar} ${styles.semanticClassNames.modalTitlebar}`}
   331→      >
   332→        <span
   333→          className={`${styles.modalTitle} ${styles.semanticClassNames.modalTitle}`}
   334→        >
   335→          Code Snippet
   336→        </span>
   337→        <button
   338→          type="button"
   339→          className={`${styles.modalIconButton} ${styles.semanticClassNames.modalIconButton}`}
   340→          onClick={handleDismiss}
   341→        >
   342→          <X size={14} />
   343→        </button>
   344→      </div>
   345→
   346→      {/* Body */}
   347→      <div
   348→        className={`${styles.modalBody} ${styles.semanticClassNames.modalBody}`}
   349→      >
   350→        {/* Sidebar */}
   351→        <div
   352→          className={`${styles.modalSidebar} ${styles.semanticClassNames.modalSidebar}`}
   353→        >
   354→          <div
   355→            className={`${styles.sidebarHeader} ${styles.semanticClassNames.sidebarHeader}`}
   356→          >
   357→            <span>Files</span>
   358→            <button
   359→              type="button"
   360→              className={`${styles.sidebarAddButton} ${styles.semanticClassNames.sidebarAddButton}`}
   361→              onClick={handleAddFile}
   362→              aria-label="Add file"
   363→            >
   364→              <Plus size={14} />
   365→            </button>
   366→          </div>
   367→          <div
   368→            className={`${styles.fileList} ${styles.semanticClassNames.fileList}`}
   369→          >
   370→            <DndContext
   371→              sensors={sensors}
   372→              collisionDetection={closestCenter}
   373→              onDragStart={(event) =>
   374→                setDragActiveId(event.active.id as string)
   375→              }
   376→              onDragEnd={handleDragEnd}
   377→              onDragCancel={() => setDragActiveId(null)}
   378→            >
   379→              <SortableContext
   380→                items={fileIds}
   381→                strategy={verticalListSortingStrategy}
   382→              >
   383→                {editFiles.map((file) => (
   384→                  <SortableFileItem
   385→                    key={file.filename}
   386→                    file={file}
   387→                    isActive={file.filename === activeFilename}
   388→                    isEditing={editingFilename === file.filename}
   389→                    editValue={newFilenameInput}
   390→                    canDelete={editFiles.length > 1}
   391→                    onSelect={() => setActiveFilename(file.filename)}
   392→                    onStartRename={() => {
   393→                      setEditingFilename(file.filename)
   394→                      setNewFilenameInput(file.filename)
   395→                    }}
   396→                    onEditChange={setNewFilenameInput}
   397→                    onCommitRename={() =>

   399→                    }
   400→                    onCancelRename={() => setEditingFilename(null)}

   404→              </SortableContext>
   405→
   406→              {typeof document !== 'undefined'

   411→                        style={{ display: 'contents' }}
   412→                      >
   413→                        {dragActiveFile ? (

   415→                            className={`${styles.fileItem()} ${styles.semanticClassNames.fileItem} ${styles.dragOverlay} ${styles.semanticClassNames.dragOverlay}`}
   416→                          >
```

```text
     6→import type {

    19→function createContentEditor(): LexicalEditor {

    23→    theme: editorTheme,

    28→}
    29→
    30→export class NestedDocEditNode extends NestedDocNode {

    33→  static commandItems: CommandItemConfig[] = [

    42→      onSelect: (editor) => {

    44→          $insertNodes([$createNestedDocEditNode()])
    45→        })
    46→      },
    47→    },
    48→  ]
    49→
    50→  static clone(node: NestedDocEditNode): NestedDocEditNode {
    51→    const cloned = new NestedDocEditNode(node.__contentState, node.__key)
    52→    cloned.__contentEditor = node.__contentEditor

    55→
    56→  constructor(contentState?: SerializedEditorState, key?: string) {

    74→
```

```text
    65→    image.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Failed to load image'))
    66→    image.src = src
    67→  })
    68→}
    69→
    70→function readAsDataUrl(file: File): Promise<string> {
    71→  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    72→    const reader = new FileReader()
    73→    reader.onload = () => resolve(String(reader.result))
    74→    reader.onerror = () => reject(reader.error ?? new Error('File read failed'))
    75→    reader.readAsDataURL(file)
    76→  })
    77→}
    78→
    79→export async function defaultImageUpload(
    80→  file: File,
    81→): Promise<ImageUploadResult> {
    82→  return {
    83→    src: await readAsDataUrl(file),
    84→    altText: file.name,
    85→  }
    86→}
    87→
    88→interface ImageUploadPluginProps {
    89→  onUpload: ImageUploadFn
    90→}
    91→
    92→export function ImageUploadPlugin({ onUpload }: ImageUploadPluginProps) {
    93→  const [editor] = useLexicalComposerContext()
    94→  const uploadRef = useRef(onUpload)
    95→  uploadRef.current = onUpload
    96→  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)
    97→  const toastTimerRef = useRef<number | null>(null)
    98→
    99→  const [dialogOpen, setDialogOpen] = useState(false)
   100→  const [tab, setTab] = useState<'upload' | 'url'>('upload')
   101→  const [rootDragActive, setRootDragActive] = useState(false)
   102→  const [dialogDragActive, setDialogDragActive] = useState(false)
   103→  const [pendingUploads, setPendingUploads] = useState(0)
   104→  const [dialogUploading, setDialogUploading] = useState(false)
   105→  const [toast, setToast] = useState<null | {
   106→    kind: 'success' | 'error'
   107→    message: string
   108→  }>(null)
   109→
   110→  const [urlInput, setUrlInput] = useState('')
   111→  const [urlPreview, setUrlPreview] = useState<string | null>(null)
   112→  const [urlMeta, setUrlMeta] = useState<{
   113→    width: number
   114→    height: number
   115→  } | null>(null)
   116→  const [urlLoading, setUrlLoading] = useState(false)
   117→  const [urlError, setUrlError] = useState<string | null>(null)
   118→
   119→  const tabItems = useMemo(
   120→    () => [
   121→      { value: 'upload' as const, label: 'Upload' },
   122→      { value: 'url' as const, label: 'URL' },
   123→    ],
   124→    [],
   125→  )
   126→
   127→  const pushToast = useCallback(
   128→    (kind: 'success' | 'error', message: string) => {
   129→      setToast({ kind, message })
   130→      if (toastTimerRef.current) {
   131→        window.clearTimeout(toastTimerRef.current)
   132→      }
   133→      toastTimerRef.current = window.setTimeout(setToast, 2200, null)
   134→    },
   135→    [],
   136→  )
   137→
   138→  const insertByUpload = useCallback(
   139→    async (file: File, options?: { closeDialog?: boolean }) => {
   140→      if (!isImageFile(file)) return false
   141→
   142→      const closeDialog = Boolean(options?.closeDialog)
   143→
   144→      setPendingUploads((value) => value + 1)
   145→      if (closeDialog) setDialogUploading(true)
   146→
   147→      try {
   148→        const [result, meta] = await Promise.all([
   149→          uploadRef.current(file),
   150→          computeImageMeta(file),
   151→        ])
   152→
   153→        editor.update(() => {
   154→          const node = $createImageNode({
   155→            src: result.src,
   156→            altText: result.altText ?? file.name,
   157→            width: result.width ?? meta.width,
   158→            height: result.height ?? meta.height,
   159→            thumbhash: result.thumbhash ?? meta.thumbhash,
   160→          })
   161→          $insertNodes([node])
   162→        })
   163→
   164→        if (closeDialog) {
   165→          setDialogOpen(false)
   166→          setUrlInput('')
   167→          setUrlPreview(null)
   168→          setUrlMeta(null)
   169→          setUrlError(null)
   170→        }
   171→        pushToast('success', 'Image uploaded')
   172→        return true
   173→      } catch (err: unknown) {
   174→        console.error('[ImageUploadPlugin]', err)
   175→        pushToast('error', 'Image upload failed')
   176→        return false
   177→      } finally {
   178→        setPendingUploads((value) => Math.max(value - 1, 0))
   179→        setDialogUploading(false)
   180→      }
   181→    },
   182→    [editor, pushToast],
   183→  )
   184→
   185→  const handleFiles = useCallback(
   186→    (files: File[]): boolean => {
   187→      const images = files.filter(isImageFile)
   188→      if (images.length === 0) return false
   189→
   190→      for (const file of images) {
   191→        void insertByUpload(file)
   192→      }
   193→      return true
   194→    },
   195→    [insertByUpload],
   196→  )
   197→
   198→  useEffect(() => {
   199→    const unregisterDragDrop = editor.registerCommand(
   200→      DRAG_DROP_PASTE,
   201→      (files: File[]) => handleFiles(files),
   202→      COMMAND_PRIORITY_HIGH,
   203→    )
   204→
   205→    const unregisterPaste = editor.registerCommand(
   206→      PASTE_COMMAND,
   207→      (event: ClipboardEvent | InputEvent | KeyboardEvent) => {
   208→        const clipboardData =
   209→          'clipboardData' in event
   210→            ? (event as ClipboardEvent).clipboardData
   211→            : null
   212→        if (!clipboardData) return false
   213→
   214→        const files = [...clipboardData.files]
   215→        if (files.some(isImageFile)) {
   216→          return handleFiles(files)
   217→        }
   218→        return false
   219→      },
   220→      COMMAND_PRIORITY_HIGH,
   221→    )
   222→
   223→    const unregisterOpenDialog = editor.registerCommand(
   224→      OPEN_IMAGE_UPLOAD_DIALOG_COMMAND,
   225→      () => {
   226→        setDialogOpen(true)
   227→        return true
   228→      },
   229→      COMMAND_PRIORITY_EDITOR,
   230→    )
   231→
   232→    const rootElement = editor.getRootElement()
   233→    const wrapper = rootElement?.parentElement ?? null
   234→    if (!wrapper) {
   235→      return () => {
   236→        unregisterDragDrop()
   237→        unregisterPaste()
   238→        unregisterOpenDialog()
   239→      }
   240→    }
   241→
   242→    let dragCounter = 0
   243→
   244→    const setWrapperDragging = (next: boolean) => {
   245→      setRootDragActive(next)
   246→      wrapper.classList.toggle(css.draggingWrapperClass, next)
   247→    }
   248→
   249→    const onDragEnter = (event: DragEvent) => {
   250→      if (!hasImageData(event.dataTransfer)) return
   251→      dragCounter += 1
   252→      setWrapperDragging(true)
   253→    }
   254→
   255→    const onDragOver = (event: DragEvent) => {
   256→      if (!hasImageData(event.dataTransfer)) return
   257→      event.preventDefault()
   258→    }
   259→
   260→    const onDragLeave = () => {
   261→      dragCounter = Math.max(dragCounter - 1, 0)
   262→      if (dragCounter === 0) {
   263→        setWrapperDragging(false)
   264→      }
   265→    }
   266→
   267→    const onDrop = () => {
   268→      dragCounter = 0
   269→      setWrapperDragging(false)
   270→    }
   271→
   272→    rootElement?.addEventListener('dragenter', onDragEnter)
   273→    rootElement?.addEventListener('dragover', onDragOver)
   274→    rootElement?.addEventListener('dragleave', onDragLeave)
   275→    rootElement?.addEventListener('drop', onDrop)
   276→
   277→    return () => {
   278→      if (toastTimerRef.current) {
   279→        window.clearTimeout(toastTimerRef.current)
   280→      }
   281→      unregisterDragDrop()
   282→      unregisterPaste()
   283→      unregisterOpenDialog()
   284→      setWrapperDragging(false)
   285→      rootElement?.removeEventListener('dragenter', onDragEnter)
   286→      rootElement?.removeEventListener('dragover', onDragOver)
   287→      rootElement?.removeEventListener('dragleave', onDragLeave)
   288→      rootElement?.removeEventListener('drop', onDrop)
   289→    }
   290→  }, [editor, handleFiles])
   291→
   292→  const resetUrlState = useCallback(() => {
   293→    setUrlInput('')
   294→    setUrlPreview(null)
   295→    setUrlMeta(null)
   296→    setUrlError(null)
   297→    setUrlLoading(false)
   298→  }, [])
   299→
   300→  const handleDialogFile = useCallback(
   301→    async (file: File | null) => {
   302→      if (!file) return
   303→      await insertByUpload(file, { closeDialog: true })
   304→    },
   305→    [insertByUpload],
   306→  )
   307→
   308→  const handleUrlPreview = useCallback(async () => {
   309→    const nextUrl = urlInput.trim()
   310→    if (!nextUrl) return
   311→    if (!isSafeImageUrl(nextUrl)) {
   312→      setUrlError('Unsupported URL scheme')
   313→      return
   314→    }
   315→
   316→    setUrlLoading(true)
   317→    setUrlError(null)
   318→    try {

   321→      setUrlPreview(nextUrl)

   324→      setUrlMeta(null)
   325→      setUrlError('Could not load this image URL')
   326→    } finally {
   327→      setUrlLoading(false)
   328→    }
   329→  }, [urlInput])
   330→
   331→  const handleInsertByUrl = useCallback(() => {

   333→
   334→    editor.update(() => {

   345→    resetUrlState()
   346→  }, [editor, pushToast, resetUrlState, urlMeta, urlPreview])
   347→
   348→  const helperMessage =
   349→    pendingUploads > 0
   350→      ? `Uploading ${pendingUploads} image${pendingUploads > 1 ? 's' : ''}...`
   351→      : rootDragActive

   378→      <Dialog

   398→          <div className={css.dialogBody}>

   407→
   408→            {tab === 'upload' ? (

   416→                onKeyDown={(event) => {

   421→                onDragEnter={(event) => {

   427→                onDragOver={(event) => {
```

```text
     1→import { rgbaToThumbHash, thumbHashToDataURL } from 'thumbhash'
     2→
     3→const MAX_DIM = 100
     4→
     5→export async function computeImageMeta(
     6→  file: File,
     7→): Promise<{ width: number; height: number; thumbhash: string }> {
     8→  const url = URL.createObjectURL(file)
     9→  try {
    10→    const img = await loadImage(url)
    11→    const { naturalWidth: w, naturalHeight: h } = img
    12→
    13→    const scale = Math.min(MAX_DIM / w, MAX_DIM / h, 1)
    14→    const sw = Math.round(w * scale)
    15→    const sh = Math.round(h * scale)
    16→
    17→    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas')
    18→    canvas.width = sw
    19→    canvas.height = sh
    20→    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d')!
    21→    ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, sw, sh)
    22→    const { data } = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, sw, sh)
    23→
    24→    const hash = rgbaToThumbHash(sw, sh, data)
    25→    const thumbhash = uint8ToBase64(hash)
    26→
    27→    return { width: w, height: h, thumbhash }
    28→  } finally {
    29→    URL.revokeObjectURL(url)
    30→  }
    31→}
    32→
    33→function loadImage(src: string): Promise<HTMLImageElement> {
    34→  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    35→    const img = new Image()
    36→    img.onload = () => resolve(img)
    37→    img.onerror = reject
    38→    img.src = src
    39→  })
    40→}
    41→
    42→export function decodeThumbHash(hash: string): string | undefined {
    43→  try {
    44→    const bytes = base64ToUint8(hash)
    45→    return thumbHashToDataURL(bytes)
    46→  } catch {
    47→    return undefined
    48→  }
    49→}
    50→
    51→function uint8ToBase64(bytes: Uint8Array): string {
    52→  let bin = ''
    53→  for (const b of bytes) bin += String.fromCodePoint(b)
    54→  return btoa(bin)
    55→}
    56→
    57→function base64ToUint8(str: string): Uint8Array {
    58→  const bin = atob(str)
    59→  const bytes = new Uint8Array(bin.length)
    60→  for (let i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) bytes[i] = bin.codePointAt(i)!
    61→  return bytes
    62→}
    63→
```

```tsx
import type { ReactNode } from 'react';
import { createContext, use } from 'react';

import type { ImageUploadFn } from '../plugins/ImageUploadPlugin';

const ImageUploadContext = createContext<ImageUploadFn | null>(null);

export function ImageUploadProvider({
  upload,
  children,
}: {
  upload: ImageUploadFn;
  children: ReactNode;
}) {
  return <ImageUploadContext.Provider value={upload}>{children}</ImageUploadContext.Provider>;
}

export function useImageUpload(): ImageUploadFn | null {
  return use(ImageUploadContext);
}
```

```tsx
export type ImageUploadFn = (file: File) => Promise<ImageUploadResult>;

function isImageFile(file: File): boolean {
  return file.type.startsWith('image/');
}

function hasImageData(dataTransfer: DataTransfer | null): boolean {
  if (!dataTransfer) return false;

  if ([...dataTransfer.files].some(isImageFile)) return true;
  return [...dataTransfer.items].some((item) => item.type.startsWith('image/'));
}

const UNSAFE_URL_RE = /^(?:javascript\s*:|vbscript\s*:|data\s*:(?!image\/))/i;

function isSafeImageUrl(url: string): boolean {
  return !UNSAFE_URL_RE.test(url);
}

function loadImageByUrl(src: string): Promise<{ width: number; height: number }> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const image = new Image();
    image.onload = () => {
      resolve({
        width: image.naturalWidth || image.width,
        height: image.naturalHeight || image.height,
      });
    };
    image.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Failed to load image'));
    image.src = src;
  });
}

function readAsDataUrl(file: File): Promise<string> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = () => resolve(String(reader.result));
    reader.onerror = () => reject(reader.error ?? new Error('File read failed'));
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  });
}

export async function defaultImageUpload(file: File): Promise<ImageUploadResult> {
  return {
    src: await readAsDataUrl(file),
    altText: file.name,
  };
}

interface ImageUploadPluginProps {
  onUpload: ImageUploadFn;
}

export function ImageUploadPlugin({ onUpload }: ImageUploadPluginProps) {
  const [editor] = useLexicalComposerContext();
  const uploadRef = useRef(onUpload);
  uploadRef.current = onUpload;
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const toastTimerRef = useRef<number | null>(null);

  const [dialogOpen, setDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<'upload' | 'url'>('upload');
  const [rootDragActive, setRootDragActive] = useState(false);
  const [dialogDragActive, setDialogDragActive] = useState(false);
  const [pendingUploads, setPendingUploads] = useState(0);
  const [dialogUploading, setDialogUploading] = useState(false);
  const [toast, setToast] = useState<null | {
    kind: 'success' | 'error';
    message: string;
  }>(null);

  const [urlInput, setUrlInput] = useState('');
  const [urlPreview, setUrlPreview] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [urlMeta, setUrlMeta] = useState<{
    width: number;
    height: number;
  } | null>(null);
  const [urlLoading, setUrlLoading] = useState(false);
  const [urlError, setUrlError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const tabItems = useMemo(
    () => [
      { value: 'upload' as const, label: 'Upload' },
      { value: 'url' as const, label: 'URL' },
    ],
    [],
  );

  const pushToast = useCallback((kind: 'success' | 'error', message: string) => {
    setToast({ kind, message });
    if (toastTimerRef.current) {
      window.clearTimeout(toastTimerRef.current);
    }
    toastTimerRef.current = window.setTimeout(setToast, 2200, null);
  }, []);

  const insertByUpload = useCallback(
    async (file: File, options?: { closeDialog?: boolean }) => {
      if (!isImageFile(file)) return false;

      const closeDialog = Boolean(options?.closeDialog);

      setPendingUploads((value) => value + 1);
      if (closeDialog) setDialogUploading(true);

      try {
        const [result, meta] = await Promise.all([uploadRef.current(file), computeImageMeta(file)]);

        editor.update(() => {
          const node = $createImageNode({
            src: result.src,
            altText: result.altText ?? file.name,
            width: result.width ?? meta.width,
            height: result.height ?? meta.height,
            thumbhash: result.thumbhash ?? meta.thumbhash,
          });
          $insertNodes([node]);
        });

        if (closeDialog) {
          setDialogOpen(false);
          setUrlInput('');
          setUrlPreview(null);
          setUrlMeta(null);
          setUrlError(null);
        }
        pushToast('success', 'Image uploaded');
        return true;
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        console.error('[ImageUploadPlugin]', err);
        pushToast('error', 'Image upload failed');
        return false;
      } finally {
        setPendingUploads((value) => Math.max(value - 1, 0));
        setDialogUploading(false);
      }
    },
    [editor, pushToast],
  );

  const handleFiles = useCallback(
    (files: File[]): boolean => {
      const images = files.filter(isImageFile);
      if (images.length === 0) return false;

      for (const file of images) {
        void insertByUpload(file);
      }
      return true;
    },
    [insertByUpload],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    const unregisterDragDrop = editor.registerCommand(
      DRAG_DROP_PASTE,
      (files: File[]) => handleFiles(files),
      COMMAND_PRIORITY_HIGH,
    );

    const unregisterPaste = editor.registerCommand(
      PASTE_COMMAND,
      (event: ClipboardEvent | InputEvent | KeyboardEvent) => {
        const clipboardData =
          'clipboardData' in event ? (event as ClipboardEvent).clipboardData : null;
        if (!clipboardData) return false;

        const files = [...clipboardData.files];
        if (files.some(isImageFile)) {
          return handleFiles(files);
        }
        return false;
      },
      COMMAND_PRIORITY_HIGH,
    );

    const unregisterOpenDialog = editor.registerCommand(
      OPEN_IMAGE_UPLOAD_DIALOG_COMMAND,
      () => {
        setDialogOpen(true);
        return true;
      },
      COMMAND_PRIORITY_EDITOR,
    );

    const rootElement = editor.getRootElement();
    const wrapper = rootElement?.parentElement ?? null;
    if (!wrapper) {
      return () => {
        unregisterDragDrop();
        unregisterPaste();
        unregisterOpenDialog();
      };
    }

    let dragCounter = 0;

    const setWrapperDragging = (next: boolean) => {
      setRootDragActive(next);
      wrapper.classList.toggle(css.draggingWrapperClass, next);
    };

    const onDragEnter = (event: DragEvent) => {
      if (!hasImageData(event.dataTransfer)) return;
      dragCounter += 1;
      setWrapperDragging(true);
    };

    const onDragOver = (event: DragEvent) => {
      if (!hasImageData(event.dataTransfer)) return;
      event.preventDefault();
    };

    const onDragLeave = () => {
      dragCounter = Math.max(dragCounter - 1, 0);
      if (dragCounter === 0) {
        setWrapperDragging(false);
      }
    };

    const onDrop = () => {
      dragCounter = 0;
      setWrapperDragging(false);
    };

    rootElement?.addEventListener('dragenter', onDragEnter);
    rootElement?.addEventListener('dragover', onDragOver);
    rootElement?.addEventListener('dragleave', onDragLeave);
    rootElement?.addEventListener('drop', onDrop);

    return () => {
      if (toastTimerRef.current) {
        window.clearTimeout(toastTimerRef.current);
      }
      unregisterDragDrop();
      unregisterPaste();
      unregisterOpenDialog();
      setWrapperDragging(false);
      rootElement?.removeEventListener('dragenter', onDragEnter);
      rootElement?.removeEventListener('dragover', onDragOver);
      rootElement?.removeEventListener('dragleave', onDragLeave);
      rootElement?.removeEventListener('drop', onDrop);
    };
  }, [editor, handleFiles]);

  const resetUrlState = useCallback(() => {
    setUrlInput('');
    setUrlPreview(null);
    setUrlMeta(null);
    setUrlError(null);
    setUrlLoading(false);
  }, []);

  const handleDialogFile = useCallback(
    async (file: File | null) => {
      if (!file) return;
      await insertByUpload(file, { closeDialog: true });
    },
    [insertByUpload],
  );

  const handleUrlPreview = useCallback(async () => {
    const nextUrl = urlInput.trim();
    if (!nextUrl) return;
    if (!isSafeImageUrl(nextUrl)) {
      setUrlError('Unsupported URL scheme');
      return;
    }

    setUrlLoading(true);
    setUrlError(null);
    try {
      const meta = await loadImageByUrl(nextUrl);
      setUrlMeta(meta);
      setUrlPreview(nextUrl);
    } catch {
      setUrlPreview(null);
      setUrlMeta(null);
      setUrlError('Could not load this image URL');
    } finally {
      setUrlLoading(false);
    }
  }, [urlInput]);

  const handleInsertByUrl = useCallback(() => {
    if (!urlPreview || !isSafeImageUrl(urlPreview)) return;

    editor.update(() => {
      const node = $createImageNode({
        src: urlPreview,
        altText: '',
        width: urlMeta?.width,
        height: urlMeta?.height,
      });
      $insertNodes([node]);
    });
    pushToast('success', 'Image inserted');
    setDialogOpen(false);
    resetUrlState();
  }, [editor, pushToast, resetUrlState, urlMeta, urlPreview]);

  const helperMessage =
    pendingUploads > 0
      ? `Uploading ${pendingUploads} image${pendingUploads > 1 ? 's' : ''}...`
      : rootDragActive
        ? 'Drop image files to upload'
        : null;

  return (
    <>
      {(helperMessage || toast) && (
        <div className={css.toastStack}>
          {helperMessage && (
            <div className={`${css.toast} ${css.toastVariant.info}`}>
              <span className={css.spinner} />
              {helperMessage}
            </div>
          )}
          {toast && (
            <div className={`${css.toast} ${css.toastVariant[toast.kind]}`}>
              {toast.kind === 'success' ? <Check size={12} /> : <Info size={12} />}
              {toast.message}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      <Dialog
        open={dialogOpen}
        onOpenChange={(nextOpen) => {
          if (!nextOpen && dialogUploading) return;
          setDialogOpen(nextOpen);
          if (!nextOpen) {
            resetUrlState();
            setDialogUploading(false);
            setDialogDragActive(false);
          }
        }}
      >
        <DialogPopup className={css.dialogPopup} showCloseButton={!dialogUploading}>
          <div className={css.dialogHeader}>
            <DialogTitle className={css.dialogTitle}>Insert image</DialogTitle>
          </div>

          <div className={css.dialogBody}>
            <div className={css.tabWrap}>
              <SegmentedControl items={tabItems} value={tab} onChange={setTab} fullWidth />
            </div>

            {tab === 'upload' ? (
              <div
                role="button"
                tabIndex={0}
                className={`${css.uploadDropzone} ${css.uploadDropzoneState[dialogUploading ? 'busy' : dialogDragActive ? 'active' : 'idle']}`}
                onClick={() => {
                  if (!dialogUploading) fileInputRef.current?.click();
                }}
                onKeyDown={(event) => {
                  if (event.key !== 'Enter' && event.key !== ' ') return;
                  event.preventDefault();
                  if (!dialogUploading) fileInputRef.current?.click();
                }}
                onDragEnter={(event) => {
                  if (hasImageData(event.dataTransfer)) {
                    event.preventDefault();
                    setDialogDragActive(true);
                  }
                }}
                onDragOver={(event) => {
                  if (hasImageData(event.dataTransfer)) {
                    event.preventDefault();
                  }
                }}
                onDragLeave={() => setDialogDragActive(false)}
                onDrop={(event) => {
                  event.preventDefault();
                  setDialogDragActive(false);
                  const file = [...event.dataTransfer.files].find(isImageFile);
                  void handleDialogFile(file ?? null);
                }}
              >
                <input
                  ref={fileInputRef}
                  className={css.hiddenInput}
                  type="file"
                  accept="image/*"
                  onChange={(event) => {
                    const file = event.currentTarget.files?.[0] ?? null;
                    void handleDialogFile(file);
                    event.currentTarget.value = '';
                  }}
                />

                {dialogUploading ? (
                  <div className={css.uploadBusyWrap}>
                    <div className={css.uploadProgress}>
                      <span className={css.spinner} />
                      Uploading image...
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <span className={css.uploadDropIcon}>
                      <Upload size={18} />
                    </span>
                    <span className={css.uploadDropTitle}>Click to upload or drag and drop</span>
                    <span className={css.uploadDropDesc}>PNG, JPG, GIF, WebP</span>
                  </>
                )}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <>
                <div className={css.urlInputRow}>
                  <input
                    className={css.textInput}
                    type="url"
                    placeholder="https://example.com/image.jpg"
                    value={urlInput}
                    onChange={(event) => {
                      setUrlInput(event.target.value);
                      setUrlError(null);
                      setUrlPreview(null);
                      setUrlMeta(null);
                    }}
                    onKeyDown={(event) => {
                      if (event.key === 'Enter') {
                        event.preventDefault();
                        if (urlPreview) {
                          handleInsertByUrl();
                        } else {
                          void handleUrlPreview();
                        }
                      }
                    }}
                  />
                  <ActionButton
                    variant="outline"
                    size="md"
                    disabled={urlLoading || !urlInput.trim()}
                    onClick={() => void handleUrlPreview()}
                  >
                    {urlLoading ? 'Loading' : 'Preview'}
                  </ActionButton>
                  <ActionButton
                    variant="accent"
                    size="md"
                    disabled={!urlPreview}
                    onClick={handleInsertByUrl}
                  >
                    Insert
                  </ActionButton>
                </div>

                {urlError && (
                  <span className={`${css.helperText} ${css.toastVariant.error}`}>
                    <Info size={12} />
                    {urlError}
                  </span>
                )}

                {urlPreview && (
                  <div className={css.urlPreview}>
                    <img className={css.urlPreviewImage} src={urlPreview} alt="Preview" />
                  </div>
                )}
              </>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className={css.dialogFooter}>
            <span className={css.helperText}>
              <Link2 size={12} />
              You can also paste images or drag files directly into the editor.
            </span>
            <ActionBar>
              <ActionButton
                variant="outline"
                size="md"
                onClick={() => setDialogOpen(false)}
                disabled={dialogUploading}
              >
                Close
              </ActionButton>
            </ActionBar>
          </div>
        </DialogPopup>
      </Dialog>
    </>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { allEditNodes } from '../config-edit';
import { ImageUploadProvider } from '../context/ImageUploadContext';
import { AlertPlugin } from '../plugins/AlertPlugin';
import { BlockIdPlugin } from '../plugins/BlockIdPlugin';
import { ImagePlugin } from '../plugins/ImagePlugin';
import { defaultImageUpload, ImageUploadPlugin } from '../plugins/ImageUploadPlugin';
import { KaTeXPlugin } from '../plugins/KaTeXPlugin';
import { LinkFaviconPlugin } from '../plugins/LinkFaviconPlugin';
import { MermaidPlugin } from '../plugins/MermaidPlugin';
import type { RichEditorProps } from '../types';
import { CorePlugins } from './CorePlugins';
import { RichEditorShell } from './RichEditorShell';

export function RichEditor({ extraNodes, imageUpload, children, ...shellProps }: RichEditorProps) {
  const nodes = extraNodes ? [...allEditNodes, ...extraNodes] : allEditNodes;
  const resolvedImageUpload = imageUpload ?? defaultImageUpload;

  return (
    <ImageUploadProvider upload={resolvedImageUpload}>
      <RichEditorShell nodes={nodes} {...shellProps}>
        <CorePlugins />
        <ImagePlugin />
        <ImageUploadPlugin onUpload={resolvedImageUpload} />
        <KaTeXPlugin />
        <AlertPlugin />
        <MermaidPlugin />
        <LinkFaviconPlugin />
        <BlockIdPlugin />
        {children}
      </RichEditorShell>
    </ImageUploadProvider>
  );
}
```

# Finishing a Development Branch

## Overview

Guide completion of development work by presenting clear options and handling chosen workflow.

**Core principle:** Verify tests → Present options → Execute choice → Clean up.

**Announce at start:** "I'm using the finishing-a-development-branch skill to complete this work."

## The Process

### Step 1: Verify Tests

**Before presenting options, verify tests pass:**

```bash
# Run project's test suite
npm test / cargo test / pytest / go test ./...
```

**If tests fail:**

```
Tests failing (<N> failures). Must fix before completing:

[Show failures]

Cannot proceed with merge/PR until tests pass.
```

Stop. Don't proceed to Step 2.

**If tests pass:** Continue to Step 2.

### Step 2: Determine Base Branch

```bash
# Try common base branches
git merge-base HEAD main 2> /dev/null || git merge-base HEAD master 2> /dev/null
```

Or ask: "This branch split from main - is that correct?"

### Step 3: Present Options

Present exactly these 4 options:

```
Implementation complete. What would you like to do?

1. Merge back to <base-branch> locally
2. Push and create a Pull Request
3. Keep the branch as-is (I'll handle it later)
4. Discard this work

Which option?
```

**Don't add explanation** - keep options concise.

### Step 4: Execute Choice

#### Option 1: Merge Locally

```bash
# Switch to base branch
git checkout <base-branch>

# Pull latest
git pull

# Merge feature branch
git merge <feature-branch>

# Verify tests on merged result
<test command>

# If tests pass
git branch -d <feature-branch>
```

Then: Cleanup worktree (Step 5)

#### Option 2: Push and Create PR

```bash
# Push branch
git push -u origin <feature-branch>

# Create PR
gh pr create --title "<title>" --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
## Summary
<2-3 bullets of what changed>

## Test Plan
- [ ] <verification steps>
EOF
)"
```

Then: Cleanup worktree (Step 5)

#### Option 3: Keep As-Is

Report: "Keeping branch <name>. Worktree preserved at <path>."

**Don't cleanup worktree.**

#### Option 4: Discard

**Confirm first:**

```
This will permanently delete:
- Branch <name>
- All commits: <commit-list>
- Worktree at <path>

Type 'discard' to confirm.
```

Wait for exact confirmation.

If confirmed:

```bash
git checkout <base-branch>
git branch -D <feature-branch>
```

Then: Cleanup worktree (Step 5)

### Step 5: Cleanup Worktree

**For Options 1, 2, 4:**

Check if in worktree:

```bash
git worktree list | grep $(git branch --show-current)
```

If yes:

```bash
git worktree remove <worktree-path>
```

**For Option 3:** Keep worktree.

## Quick Reference

| Option           | Merge | Push | Keep Worktree | Cleanup Branch |
| ---------------- | ----- | ---- | ------------- | -------------- |
| 1. Merge locally | ✓     | -    | -             | ✓              |
| 2. Create PR     | -     | ✓    | ✓             | -              |
| 3. Keep as-is    | -     | -    | ✓             | -              |
| 4. Discard       | -     | -    | -             | ✓ (force)      |

## Common Mistakes

**Skipping test verification**

- **Problem:** Merge broken code, create failing PR
- **Fix:** Always verify tests before offering options

**Open-ended questions**

- **Problem:** "What should I do next?" → ambiguous
- **Fix:** Present exactly 4 structured options

**Automatic worktree cleanup**

- **Problem:** Remove worktree when might need it (Option 2, 3)
- **Fix:** Only cleanup for Options 1 and 4

**No confirmation for discard**

- **Problem:** Accidentally delete work
- **Fix:** Require typed "discard" confirmation

## Red Flags

**Never:**

- Proceed with failing tests
- Merge without verifying tests on result
- Delete work without confirmation
- Force-push without explicit request

**Always:**

- Verify tests before offering options
- Present exactly 4 options
- Get typed confirmation for Option 4
- Clean up worktree for Options 1 & 4 only

## Integration

**Called by:**

- **subagent-driven-development** (Step 7) - After all tasks complete
- **executing-plans** (Step 5) - After all batches complete

**Pairs with:**

- **using-git-worktrees** - Cleans up worktree created by that skill

```text
    88→  const cloned: SerializedTextNodeLike = {
    89→    ...node,
    90→    text,
    91→    style,
    92→  }
    93→  return cloned as SerializedLexicalNode

    96→function cloneNodeWithChildren(
    97→  node: SerializedLexicalNode,
    98→  children: SerializedLexicalNode[],
    99→): SerializedLexicalNode {
   100→  return {
   101→    ...(node as NodeRecord),
   102→    children,

   105→
   106→function decorateSubtree(
   107→  node: SerializedLexicalNode,
   108→  kind: MarkKind,
   109→): SerializedLexicalNode {
   110→  if (isTextNode(node)) {
   111→    return cloneTextNode(node, node.text, kind)
   112→  }
   113→
   114→  const children = getChildren(node)
   115→  if (!children) return node
   116→
   117→  return cloneNodeWithChildren(
   118→    node,
   119→    children.map((child) => decorateSubtree(child, kind)),
   120→  )
   121→}
   122→
   123→function reverseText(value: string): string {
   124→  return Array.from(value).reverse().join('')
   125→}
   126→
   127→function mergeTextOps(ops: TextDiffOp[]): TextDiffOp[] {
   128→  const merged: TextDiffOp[] = []
   129→  for (const op of ops) {
   130→    if (!op.text) continue
   131→    const last = merged.at(-1)
   132→    if (last && last.kind === op.kind) {
   133→      last.text += op.text
   134→    } else {
   135→      merged.push({ ...op })
   136→    }
   137→  }
   138→  return merged
   139→}
   140→
   141→function diffMiddleChars(oldChars: string[], newChars: string[]): TextDiffOp[] {
   142→  const m = oldChars.length
   143→  const n = newChars.length
   144→
   145→  if (m === 0 && n === 0) return []
   146→  if (m === 0) return [{ kind: 'insert', text: newChars.join('') }]
   147→  if (n === 0) return [{ kind: 'delete', text: oldChars.join('') }]
   148→
   149→  if (m * n > CHAR_DIFF_MAX_MATRIX_CELLS) {
   150→    return [
   151→      { kind: 'delete', text: oldChars.join('') },
   152→      { kind: 'insert', text: newChars.join('') },
   153→    ]
   154→  }
   155→
   156→  const dp: number[][] = Array.from({ length: m + 1 }, () =>
   157→    new Array<number>(n + 1).fill(0),
   158→  )
   159→
   160→  for (let i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
   161→    for (let j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
   162→      if (oldChars[i - 1] === newChars[j - 1]) {
   163→        dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j - 1] + 1
   164→      } else {
   165→        dp[i][j] = Math.max(dp[i - 1][j], dp[i][j - 1])
   166→      }
   167→    }
   168→  }
   169→
   170→  const reversedOps: TextDiffOp[] = []
   171→  let i = m
   172→  let j = n
   173→
   174→  while (i > 0 && j > 0) {
   175→    if (oldChars[i - 1] === newChars[j - 1]) {
   176→      const last = reversedOps.at(-1)
   177→      if (last && last.kind === 'equal') {
   178→        last.text += oldChars[i - 1]
   179→      } else {
   180→        reversedOps.push({ kind: 'equal', text: oldChars[i - 1] })
   181→      }
   182→      i--
   183→      j--
   184→      continue
   185→    }
   186→
   187→    if (dp[i - 1][j] >= dp[i][j - 1]) {
   188→      const last = reversedOps.at(-1)
   189→      if (last && last.kind === 'delete') {
   190→        last.text += oldChars[i - 1]
   191→      } else {
   192→        reversedOps.push({ kind: 'delete', text: oldChars[i - 1] })
   193→      }
   194→      i--
   195→    } else {
   196→      const last = reversedOps.at(-1)
   197→      if (last && last.kind === 'insert') {
   198→        last.text += newChars[j - 1]
   199→      } else {
   200→        reversedOps.push({ kind: 'insert', text: newChars[j - 1] })
   201→      }
   202→      j--
   203→    }
   204→  }
   205→
   206→  while (i > 0) {
   207→    const last = reversedOps.at(-1)
   208→    if (last && last.kind === 'delete') {
   209→      last.text += oldChars[i - 1]
   210→    } else {
   211→      reversedOps.push({ kind: 'delete', text: oldChars[i - 1] })
   212→    }
   213→    i--
   214→  }
   215→
   216→  while (j > 0) {
   217→    const last = reversedOps.at(-1)
   218→    if (last && last.kind === 'insert') {
   219→      last.text += newChars[j - 1]
   220→    } else {
   221→      reversedOps.push({ kind: 'insert', text: newChars[j - 1] })
   222→    }
   223→    j--
   224→  }
   225→
   226→  const forwardOps = reversedOps
   227→    .reverse()
   228→    .map((op) => ({ kind: op.kind, text: reverseText(op.text) }))
   229→
   230→  return mergeTextOps(forwardOps)
   231→}
   232→
   233→function diffTextByChar(oldText: string, newText: string): TextDiffOp[] {
   234→  const oldChars = Array.from(oldText)
   235→  const newChars = Array.from(newText)
   236→
   237→  let prefix = 0
   238→  while (
   239→    prefix < oldChars.length &&
   240→    prefix < newChars.length &&
   241→    oldChars[prefix] === newChars[prefix]
   242→  ) {
   243→    prefix++
   244→  }
   245→
   246→  let oldSuffix = oldChars.length - 1
   247→  let newSuffix = newChars.length - 1
   248→
   249→  while (
   250→    oldSuffix >= prefix &&
   251→    newSuffix >= prefix &&
   252→    oldChars[oldSuffix] === newChars[newSuffix]
   253→  ) {
   254→    oldSuffix--
   255→    newSuffix--
   256→  }
   257→
   258→  const ops: TextDiffOp[] = []
   259→  if (prefix > 0) {
   260→    ops.push({
   261→      kind: 'equal',
   262→      text: oldChars.slice(0, prefix).join(''),
   263→    })
   264→  }
   265→
   266→  ops.push(
   267→    ...diffMiddleChars(
   268→      oldChars.slice(prefix, oldSuffix + 1),
   269→      newChars.slice(prefix, newSuffix + 1),
   270→    ),
   271→  )
   272→
   273→  if (oldSuffix < oldChars.length - 1) {
   274→    ops.push({
   275→      kind: 'equal',
   276→      text: oldChars.slice(oldSuffix + 1).join(''),
   277→    })
   278→  }
   279→
   280→  return mergeTextOps(ops)
   281→}
   282→
   283→function splitTextNodeByCharDiff(
   284→  oldNode: SerializedTextNodeLike,
   285→  newNode: SerializedTextNodeLike,
   286→): {
   287→  oldNodes: SerializedLexicalNode[]
   288→  newNodes: SerializedLexicalNode[]
   289→  changed: boolean
   290→} {
   291→  const ops = diffTextByChar(oldNode.text, newNode.text)
   292→  const oldNodes: SerializedLexicalNode[] = []
   293→  const newNodes: SerializedLexicalNode[] = []
   294→  let changed = false
   295→
   296→  for (const op of ops) {
   297→    if (!op.text) continue
   298→
   299→    if (op.kind === 'equal') {
   300→      oldNodes.push(cloneTextNode(oldNode, op.text))
   301→      newNodes.push(cloneTextNode(newNode, op.text))
   302→      continue
   303→    }
   304→
   305→    changed = true
   306→    if (op.kind === 'delete') {
   307→      oldNodes.push(cloneTextNode(oldNode, op.text, 'delete'))
   308→      continue
   309→    }
   310→
   311→    newNodes.push(cloneTextNode(newNode, op.text, 'insert'))
   312→  }
   313→
   314→  return {
   315→    oldNodes: oldNodes.length > 0 ? oldNodes : [oldNode],
   316→    newNodes: newNodes.length > 0 ? newNodes : [newNode],
   317→    changed,
   318→  }
   319→}
   320→
   321→type AlignOp =
   322→  | { kind: 'equal'; node: SerializedLexicalNode }
   323→  | {
   324→      kind: 'modify'
   325→      oldNode: SerializedLexicalNode
   326→      newNode: SerializedLexicalNode
   327→    }
   328→  | { kind: 'delete'; node: SerializedLexicalNode }
   329→  | { kind: 'insert'; node: SerializedLexicalNode }
   330→
   331→/**
   332→ * LCS-based structural alignment.
   333→ *
   334→ * Scoring:
   335→ *   exact match  → +2 (always align)
   336→ *   type match   → +1 (prefer align over skip)
   337→ *   type mismatch → not considered (never align different types)
   338→ */
   339→function alignNodes(
   340→  oldNodes: SerializedLexicalNode[],
   341→  newNodes: SerializedLexicalNode[],
   342→): AlignOp[] {
   343→  const m = oldNodes.length
   344→  const n = newNodes.length
   345→
   346→  // DP table
   347→  const dp: number[][] = Array.from({ length: m + 1 }, () =>
   348→    new Array<number>(n + 1).fill(0),
   349→  )
   350→
   351→  for (let i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
   352→    for (let j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
   353→      const skip = Math.max(dp[i - 1][j], dp[i][j - 1])
   354→
   355→      if (getNodeTypeKey(oldNodes[i - 1]) === getNodeTypeKey(newNodes[j - 1])) {
   356→        const score = nodesEqual(oldNodes[i - 1], newNodes[j - 1]) ? 2 : 1
   357→        dp[i][j] = Math.max(skip, dp[i - 1][j - 1] + score)
   358→      } else {
   359→        dp[i][j] = skip
   360→      }
   361→    }
   362→  }
   363→
   364→  // Backtrack
   365→  const ops: AlignOp[] = []
   366→  let i = m
   367→  let j = n
   368→
   369→  while (i > 0 && j > 0) {
   370→    const typeMatch =
   371→      getNodeTypeKey(oldNodes[i - 1]) === getNodeTypeKey(newNodes[j - 1])
   372→
   373→    if (typeMatch) {
   374→      const exact = nodesEqual(oldNodes[i - 1], newNodes[j - 1])
   375→      const score = exact ? 2 : 1
   376→
   377→      if (dp[i][j] === dp[i - 1][j - 1] + score) {
   378→        ops.push(
   379→          exact
   380→            ? { kind: 'equal', node: oldNodes[i - 1] }
   381→            : {
   382→                kind: 'modify',
   383→                oldNode: oldNodes[i - 1],
   384→                newNode: newNodes[j - 1],
   385→              },
   386→        )
   387→        i--
   388→        j--
   389→        continue
   390→      }
   391→    }
   392→
   393→    if (dp[i - 1][j] >= dp[i][j - 1]) {
   394→      ops.push({ kind: 'delete', node: oldNodes[i - 1] })
   395→      i--
   396→    } else {
   397→      ops.push({ kind: 'insert', node: newNodes[j - 1] })
   398→      j--
   399→    }
   400→  }
   401→
   402→  while (i > 0) {
   403→    ops.push({ kind: 'delete', node: oldNodes[--i] })
   404→  }
   405→  while (j > 0) {
   406→    ops.push({ kind: 'insert', node: newNodes[--j] })
   407→  }
   408→
   409→  ops.reverse()
   410→  return ops
   411→}
   412→
   413→function diffChildrenInline(
   414→  oldChildren: SerializedLexicalNode[],
   415→  newChildren: SerializedLexicalNode[],
   416→): InlineChildrenDiffResult {
   417→  const ops = alignNodes(oldChildren, newChildren)
   418→
   419→  const nextOldChildren: SerializedLexicalNode[] = []
   420→  const nextNewChildren: SerializedLexicalNode[] = []
   421→  let changed = false
   422→
   423→  for (const op of ops) {
   424→    switch (op.kind) {
   425→      case 'equal': {
   426→        nextOldChildren.push(op.node)
   427→        nextNewChildren.push(op.node)
   428→        break
   429→      }
   430→      case 'delete': {
   431→        changed = true
   432→        nextOldChildren.push(decorateSubtree(op.node, 'delete'))
   433→        break
   434→      }
   435→      case 'insert': {
   436→        changed = true
   437→        nextNewChildren.push(decorateSubtree(op.node, 'insert'))
   438→        break
   439→      }
   440→      case 'modify': {
   441→        changed = true
   442→
   443→        if (isTextNode(op.oldNode) && isTextNode(op.newNode)) {
   444→          const textDiff = splitTextNodeByCharDiff(op.oldNode, op.newNode)
   445→          nextOldChildren.push(...textDiff.oldNodes)
   446→          nextNewChildren.push(...textDiff.newNodes)
   447→          break
   448→        }
   449→
   450→        const nested = diffNodeInline(op.oldNode, op.newNode)
   451→        if (nested) {
   452→          nextOldChildren.push(nested.oldNode)
   453→          nextNewChildren.push(nested.newNode)
   454→        } else {
   455→          nextOldChildren.push(decorateSubtree(op.oldNode, 'delete'))
   456→          nextNewChildren.push(decorateSubtree(op.newNode, 'insert'))
   457→        }
   458→        break
   459→      }
   460→    }
   461→  }
   462→
   463→  return {
   464→    oldChildren: nextOldChildren,
   465→    newChildren: nextNewChildren,
   466→    changed,
   467→  }
   468→}
   469→
   470→function diffNodeInline(
   471→  oldNode: SerializedLexicalNode,
   472→  newNode: SerializedLexicalNode,
   473→): {
   474→  oldNode: SerializedLexicalNode
   475→  newNode: SerializedLexicalNode
   476→  changed: boolean
   477→} | null {
   478→  if (getNodeTypeKey(oldNode) !== getNodeTypeKey(newNode)) return null
   479→  if (nodesEqual(oldNode, newNode)) {
   480→    return { oldNode, newNode, changed: false }
   481→  }
   482→
   483→  const oldChildren = getChildren(oldNode)
   484→  const newChildren = getChildren(newNode)
   485→  if (!oldChildren || !newChildren) return null
   486→
   487→  const childDiff = diffChildrenInline(oldChildren, newChildren)
   488→  if (!childDiff.changed) {
   489→    return { oldNode, newNode, changed: false }
   490→  }
   491→
   492→  return {
   493→    oldNode: cloneNodeWithChildren(oldNode, childDiff.oldChildren),
   494→    newNode: cloneNodeWithChildren(newNode, childDiff.newChildren),
   495→    changed: true,
   496→  }
   497→}
   498→
   499→function diffModifiedNode(
   500→  oldNode: SerializedLexicalNode,
   501→  newNode: SerializedLexicalNode,
   502→): {
   503→  oldNode: SerializedLexicalNode
   504→  newNode: SerializedLexicalNode
   505→} {
   506→  const nested = diffNodeInline(oldNode, newNode)
   507→  if (nested) {
   508→    return { oldNode: nested.oldNode, newNode: nested.newNode }
   509→  }
   510→
   511→  return {
   512→    oldNode: decorateSubtree(oldNode, 'delete'),
   513→    newNode: decorateSubtree(newNode, 'insert'),
   514→  }
   515→}
   516→
   517→export function computeDiff(
   518→  oldState: SerializedEditorState,
   519→  newState: SerializedEditorState,
   520→): DiffHunk[] {
   521→  const ops = alignNodes(oldState.root.children, newState.root.children)
   522→
   523→  const hunks: DiffHunk[] = []
   524→
   525→  for (const op of ops) {
   526→    switch (op.kind) {
   527→      case 'equal': {
   528→        const last = hunks.at(-1)
   529→        if (last && last.type === 'equal') {
   530→          last.nodes.push(op.node)
   531→        } else {
   532→          hunks.push({ type: 'equal', nodes: [op.node] })
   533→        }
   534→        break
   535→      }
   536→      case 'modify': {
   537→        // Per-node delete+insert pair — do NOT merge with neighbors
   538→        {
   539→          const inline = diffModifiedNode(op.oldNode, op.newNode)
   540→          hunks.push(
   541→            { type: 'delete', nodes: [inline.oldNode] },
   542→            { type: 'insert', nodes: [inline.newNode] },
   543→          )
   544→        }
   545→        break
   546→      }
   547→      case 'delete': {
   548→        hunks.push({
   549→          type: 'delete',
   550→          nodes: [decorateSubtree(op.node, 'delete')],
   551→        })
   552→        break
   553→      }
   554→      case 'insert': {
   555→        hunks.push({
   556→          type: 'insert',
   557→          nodes: [decorateSubtree(op.node, 'insert')],
   558→        })
   559→        break
   560→      }
   561→    }
   562→  }
   563→
   564→  return hunks
   565→}
   566→
```

```text
   216→
   217→  getAccent(): string | undefined {
   218→    return this.__accent
   219→  }
   220→
   221→  decorate(_editor: LexicalEditor, _config: EditorConfig): ReactElement {
   222→    return createRendererDecoration('Image', ImageRenderer, {
   223→      src: this.__src,
   224→      altText: this.__altText,
   225→      width: this.__width,
   226→      height: this.__height,
   227→      caption: this.__caption,
   228→      thumbhash: this.__thumbhash,
   229→      accent: this.__accent,
   230→    })
   231→  }
   232→}

   235→  return new ImageNode(payload)
   236→}
```

     1→import { $convertFromMarkdownString } from '@lexical/markdown'
     2→import { useLexicalComposerContext } from '@lexical/react/LexicalComposerContext'
     3→import type { SerializedLexicalNode } from 'lexical'
     4→import {
     5→  $insertNodes,
     6→  $parseSerializedNode,
     7→  COMMAND_PRIORITY_HIGH,
     8→  createEditor,
     9→  PASTE_COMMAND,
    10→} from 'lexical'
    11→import { useEffect } from 'react'
    12→
    13→import { getResolvedEditNodes } from '../node-registry'
    14→import { $createCodeBlockEditNode } from '../nodes/CodeBlockEditNode'
    15→import { ALL_TRANSFORMERS } from '../transformers'
    16→
    17→function getVSCodePasteData(
    18→  clipboardData: DataTransfer,
    19→): { language: string } | null {
    20→  const raw = clipboardData.getData('vscode-editor-data')
    21→  if (!raw) return null
    22→  try {
    23→    const data = JSON.parse(raw)
    24→    return { language: data.mode || 'text' }
    25→  } catch {
    26→    return null
    27→  }
    28→}
    29→
    30→function hasRichHTML(clipboardData: DataTransfer): boolean {
    31→  const html = clipboardData.getData('text/html')
    32→  if (!html) return false
    33→  if (/data-vscode|vscode-/i.test(html)) return false
    34→  const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(html, 'text/html')
    35→  const richTags = doc.body.querySelectorAll(
    36→    'strong,em,b,i,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,ul,ol,table,img,blockquote,pre>code,a[href]',
    37→  )
    38→  return richTags.length > 0
    39→}
    40→
    41→function detectMarkdown(text: string): boolean {
    42→  let score = 0
    43→
    44→  if (/^#{1,6}\s+\S/m.test(text)) score += 5
    45→  if (/^```[\w-]*$/m.test(text)) score += 5
    46→  if (/\[.+?]\(.+?\)/.test(text)) score += 4
    47→  if (/!\[.*?]\(.+?\)/.test(text)) score += 5
    48→  if (/^\|.+\|$/m.test(text) && /^\|[\s:|-]+\|$/m.test(text)) score += 5
    49→  if (/^>\s*\[!(?:note|tip|warning|caution|important)]/im.test(text))
    50→    score += 5
    51→  if (/^[*-]\s+\[[ x]]/m.test(text)) score += 4
    52→
    53→  if (/\*\*.+?\*\*/.test(text)) score += 2
    54→  if (/(?<!\*)\*(?!\*)(?!\s).+?(?<!\s)(?<!\*)\*(?!\*)/.test(text)) score += 1
    55→  if (/^[*+-]\s+\S/m.test(text)) score += 1
    56→  if (/^\d+\.\s+\S/m.test(text)) score += 1
    57→  if (/^>\s+\S/m.test(text)) score += 1
    58→  if (/`.+?`/.test(text)) score += 1
    59→  if (/^[*_-]{3,}$/m.test(text)) score += 2
    60→
    61→  const paragraphs = text.split(/\n{2,}/).filter(Boolean)
    62→  if (paragraphs.length >= 2) score += 5
    63→
    64→  if (text.length < 20) score -= 3
    65→  if (!text.includes('\n')) score -= 2
    66→
    67→  return score >= 5
    68→}
    69→
    70→function _debugPastePayload(event: Event, clipboardData: DataTransfer): void {
    71→  const itemDetails = Array.from(clipboardData.items).map((item, index) => ({
    72→    index,
    73→    kind: item.kind,
    74→    type: item.type,
    75→  }))
    76→
    77→  const fileDetails = Array.from(clipboardData.files).map((file, index) => ({
    78→    index,
    79→    name: file.name,
    80→    type: file.type,
    81→    size: file.size,
    82→    lastModified: file.lastModified,
    83→    lastModifiedISO: new Date(file.lastModified).toISOString(),
    84→  }))
    85→
    86→  const typePayload: Record<string, string> = {}
    87→  for (const type of Array.from(clipboardData.types)) {
    88→    typePayload[type] = clipboardData.getData(type)
    89→  }
    90→
    91→  console.info('[MarkdownPastePlugin] paste debug payload')
    92→  console.info('event', {
    93→    type: event.type,
    94→    defaultPrevented: event.defaultPrevented,
    95→    timeStamp: event.timeStamp,
    96→  })
    97→  console.info('clipboardMeta', {
    98→    dropEffect: clipboardData.dropEffect,
    99→    effectAllowed: clipboardData.effectAllowed,
   100→    types: Array.from(clipboardData.types),
   101→    itemsCount: clipboardData.items.length,
   102→    filesCount: clipboardData.files.length,
   103→  })
   104→  console.info('items', itemDetails)
   105→  if (fileDetails.length > 0) console.info('files', fileDetails)
   106→  console.info('payloadByType', typePayload)
   107→}
   108→
   109→function convertAndInsert(markdown: string): void {
   110→  const tempEditor = createEditor({
   111→    namespace: 'markdown-paste-temp',
   112→    nodes: getResolvedEditNodes(),
   113→    onError: () => {},
   114→  })
   115→
   116→  tempEditor.update(
   117→    () => {
   118→      $convertFromMarkdownString(markdown, ALL_TRANSFORMERS)
   119→    },
   120→    { discrete: true },
   121→  )
   122→
   123→  const serializedChildren = tempEditor.getEditorState().toJSON().root.children
   124→
   125→  const nodes = serializedChildren.map((s: SerializedLexicalNode) =>
   126→    $parseSerializedNode(s),
   127→  )
   128→  $insertNodes(nodes)
   129→}
   130→
   131→export function MarkdownPastePlugin() {
   132→  const [editor] = useLexicalComposerContext()
   133→
   134→  useEffect(() => {
   135→    return editor.registerCommand(
   136→      PASTE_COMMAND,
   137→      (event) => {
   138→        const clipboardData =
   139→          'clipboardData' in event
   140→            ? (event as ClipboardEvent).clipboardData
   141→            : null
   142→        if (!clipboardData) return false
   143→
   144→        // debugPastePayload(event as Event, clipboardData)
   145→
   146→        // Image files → let ImageUploadPlugin handle
   147→        if (
   148→          Array.from(clipboardData.files).some((f) =>
   149→            f.type.startsWith('image/'),
   150→          )
   151→        )
   152→          return false
   153→
   154→        // VS Code paste → code block(s)
   155→        const vscodeData = getVSCodePasteData(clipboardData)
   156→        if (vscodeData) {
   157→          const code = clipboardData.getData('text/plain')
   158→          if (code) {
   159→            const segments = code.split(/\r?\n{3,}/).filter(Boolean)
   160→            const nodes = segments.map((s) =>
   161→              $createCodeBlockEditNode(
   162→                s.replace(/^\s*\n/, '').replace(/\n\s*$/, ''),
   163→                vscodeData.language,
   164→              ),
   165→            )
   166→            $insertNodes(nodes)
   167→            event.preventDefault()
   168→            return true
   169→          }
   170→        }
   171→
   172→        // Rich HTML → let Lexical default handle
   173→        if (hasRichHTML(clipboardData)) return false
   174→
   175→        // Markdown detection
   176→        const text = clipboardData.getData('text/plain')
   177→        if (!text || !detectMarkdown(text)) return false
   178→
   179→        try {
   180→          event.preventDefault()
   181→          convertAndInsert(text)
   182→          return true
   183→        } catch {
   184→          return false
   185→        }
   186→      },
   187→      COMMAND_PRIORITY_HIGH,
   188→    )
   189→  }, [editor])
   190→
   191→  return null
   192→}
   193→

```text
   343→export function EmbedStaticRenderer({ type, url }: EmbedStaticRendererProps) {
```

```text
    38→  const max = m?.reduce((a, r) => Math.max(a, r.length), 0) ?? 0
    39→  return '`'.repeat(Math.max(3, max + 1))
    40→}
    41→
    42→function walkText(node: Record<string, unknown>): string {
    43→  const children = node.children as Record<string, unknown>[] | undefined
    44→  if (!children) return (node.text as string) ?? ''
    45→  return children.map(walkText).join('\n')
    46→}
    47→
    48→function stateText(state: unknown): string {
    49→  if (!state || typeof state !== 'object') return ''
    50→  const root = (state as Record<string, unknown>).root as
    51→    | Record<string, unknown>
    52→    | undefined
    53→  return root ? walkText(root) : ''
    54→}
```

```text
   104→    return Math.round(255 * color)
   105→      .toString(16)

   107→  }
   108→  return `#${f(0)}${f(8)}${f(4)}`

   111→export function generateColor(
   112→  str: string,
   113→  saturation: [number, number] = [30, 35],
   114→  lightness: [number, number] = [60, 70],
   115→): string {
   116→  let hash = 0
   117→  for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
   118→    hash = str.charCodeAt(i) + ((hash << 5) - hash)
   119→  }
   120→  const sRange = saturation[1] - saturation[0] + 1
   121→  const lRange = lightness[1] - lightness[0] + 1
   122→  const h = Math.abs(hash) % 360
   123→  const s = saturation[0] + (Math.abs(hash >> 8) % sRange)
   124→  const l = lightness[0] + (Math.abs(hash >> 16) % lRange)
   125→  return hslToHex(h, s, l)
   126→}
```

Now fix RUBY_TRANSFORMER regexes (lines 119-122). The issues are:

1. `[\S\s]` should be replaced with `.` using `s` flag
2. Backtracking-prone patterns with `\s*` and `[\S\s]*?`

The current regexes are:

```
/<ruby>\s*([\S\s]*?)\s*<rt>\s*([\S\s]*?)\s*<\/rt>\s*(?:<rp>[\S\s]*?<\/rp>\s*)*<\/ruby>/i
/<ruby>\s*([\S\s]*?)\s*<rt>\s*([\S\s]*?)\s*<\/rt>\s*(?:<rp>[\S\s]*?<\/rp>\s*)*<\/ruby>$/i
```

The backtracking issue is between `\s*` and `[\S\s]*?` since `\s` is a subset of `[\S\s]`. When replacing `[\S\s]` with `.` and using `s` flag, we still have the issue of `\s*` and `.*?` being able to exchange characters.

To fix backtracking, I need to make the patterns unambiguous. The key insight: `\s*([\S\s]*?)\s*<rt>` can be simplified. Since `[\S\s]*?` (or `.*?` with s flag) will match as little as possible up to `<rt>`, the surrounding `\s*` are redundant -- the lazy `.*?` already handles matching whitespace. But removing `\s*` changes the capture group content.

A better approach: use `[^<]*` instead of `[\S\s]*?` where the content shouldn't contain `<` (which is the case for ruby text content). This eliminates backtracking.

Actually, let me think about what ruby content looks like: `<ruby>漢字<rt>かんじ</rt></ruby>`. The base text and reading text won't contain `<`. So `[^<]*` is safe.

For the `<rp>` part: `(?:<rp>[^<]*<\/rp>\s*)*` also works.

Since `\s*` trims whitespace and `[^<]*?` captures content, I should capture non-whitespace-non-`<` content with possible internal whitespace, but not trailing whitespace. The regexes just need to exist to satisfy the type.

Release @haklex/\* packages and update all downstream consumers.

## Steps

### 1. Pre-flight checks

Run `git status` in haklex repo. Ensure working tree is clean or all changes are committed. If not, stop and ask the user.

### 2. Version bump

Read current version from `packages/rich-editor/package.json` → `version` field. Default to patch bump (increment the last segment). Run:

```bash
pnpm bumpp --no-git --no-tag < patch_version > -r
```

After bumpp completes, read the new version from `packages/rich-editor/package.json` → `version` field. Store as `$NEW_VERSION`.

### 3. Build & Publish

```bash
cd < HOME > /git/repos/haklex && pnpm build:packages && pnpm -r publish --no-git-checks --filter '@haklex/*' --filter '!@haklex/rich-editor-demo'
```

`build:packages` only builds workspace packages under `packages/`; the dev playground now lives in top-level `demo/` and remains excluded from publish.

If publish fails, stop and report.

### 4. Commit and push the version bump in haklex

Stage and commit all changed `package.json` and `pnpm-lock.yaml` files:

```
release: v$NEW_VERSION
```

Then push to remote:

```bash
git push
```

### 5. Update downstream projects

For each downstream project, update all `@haklex/*` dependency versions to `$NEW_VERSION`:

**Shiroi** — `<HOME>/git/repos/Shiroi/apps/web/package.json`

- Update `@haklex/rich-editor`, `@haklex/rich-kit-shiro`, `@haklex/rich-static-renderer`

**admin-vue3** — `<HOME>/git/repos/admin-vue3/package.json`

- Update `@haklex/rich-diff`, `@haklex/rich-ext-nested-doc`, `@haklex/rich-editor`, `@haklex/rich-editor-ui`, `@haklex/rich-kit-shiro`, `@haklex/rich-plugin-toolbar`, `@haklex/rich-style-token`

**mx-core** — `<HOME>/git/repos/mx-core/apps/core/package.json`

- Update `@haklex/rich-headless`

Use sed or Edit to replace pinned version strings. Match pattern: `"@haklex/<pkg>": "<old_version>"` → `"@haklex/<pkg>": "$NEW_VERSION"`.

### 6. Install in downstream projects

Run `pnpm install` in each downstream project root:

```bash
cd < HOME > /git/repos/Shiroi && pnpm install
cd < HOME > /git/repos/admin-vue3 && pnpm install
cd < HOME > /git/repos/mx-core && pnpm install
```

### 7. Check for new features to integrate

Compare the haklex git log since the previous version tag to identify new exports, new packages, or breaking changes:

```bash

```

If new features are found, ask the user whether to integrate them into specific downstream projects. Do NOT auto-integrate without confirmation.

### Step 7: Check for breaking changes

This release introduces **breaking import path changes**: all node/plugin/command/renderer imports from `@haklex/rich-editor` root have moved to sub-paths (`/nodes`, `/plugins`, `/commands`, `/renderers`). The `./editor` sub-path was removed.

**Shiroi** and **admin-vue3** import from `@haklex/rich-editor` and `@haklex/rich-kit-shiro`. Since `rich-kit-shiro` re-exports everything, downstream consumers are insulated — no import path changes needed in those projects.

**mx-core** only uses `@haklex/rich-headless` — unaffected.

```text
    18→  const colorScheme = useColorScheme();
    19→  const { className: portalClassName } = usePortalTheme();
    20→
    21→  const children = contentState.root?.children ?? [];
    22→  const needsTruncation = children.length > PREVIEW_NODE_LIMIT;
    23→  const previewState = useMemo(
    24→    () => truncateEditorState(contentState, PREVIEW_NODE_LIMIT),
    25→    [contentState],
    26→  );
    27→  const hasPreview = hasRenderableEditorState(contentState);
    28→
    29→  const handleOpen = useCallback(async () => {
    30→    const { presentDialog } = await import('@haklex/rich-editor-ui');
    31→
    32→    presentDialog({
    33→      content: () => (
    34→        <div className={css.staticDialogBody}>
    35→          <NestedDocRenderer value={contentState} />
    36→        </div>
    37→      ),
    38→      className: css.staticDialogPopup,
    39→      portalClassName,
    40→      theme: colorScheme,
    41→      showCloseButton: true,
    42→      clickOutsideToDismiss: true,
    43→      sheet: 'auto',
    44→    });
    45→  }, [colorScheme, contentState, portalClassName]);
    46→
    47→  if (!hasPreview) {
    48→    return null;
    49→  }
    50→
    51→  return (
    52→    <div
    53→      className={css.staticOverlayRoot}
    54→      role="button"
    55→      tabIndex={0}
    56→      onClick={handleOpen}
    57→      onKeyDown={(e) => {
    58→        if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
    59→          e.preventDefault();
    60→          handleOpen();
    61→        }
    62→      }}
    63→    >
    64→      <div className="rich-nested-doc-content">
    65→        <div className={css.previewSurface}>
    66→          <NestedDocRenderer value={previewState} />
    67→        </div>
    68→      </div>
    69→      {needsTruncation && <div aria-hidden className={css.staticGradientMask} />}
    70→      <div aria-hidden className={css.staticOverlay}>
    71→        <Maximize2 size={24} />
    72→      </div>
    73→    </div>
    74→  );
    75→}
    76→
```

Release @haklex/\* packages and update all downstream consumers.

## Steps

### 1. Pre-flight checks

Run `git status` in haklex repo. Ensure working tree is clean or all changes are committed. If not, stop and ask the user.

### 2. Version bump

Read current version from `packages/rich-editor/package.json` → `version` field. Default to patch bump (increment the last segment). Run:

```bash
pnpm bumpp --no-git --no-tag < patch_version > -r
```

After bumpp completes, read the new version from `packages/rich-editor/package.json` → `version` field. Store as `$NEW_VERSION`.

### 3. Build & Publish

```bash
cd < HOME > /git/repos/haklex && pnpm build:packages && pnpm -r publish --no-git-checks --filter '@haklex/*' --filter '!@haklex/rich-editor-demo'
```

`build:packages` only builds workspace packages under `packages/`; the dev playground now lives in top-level `demo/` and remains excluded from publish.

If publish fails, stop and report.

### 4. Commit and push the version bump in haklex

Stage and commit all changed `package.json` and `pnpm-lock.yaml` files:

```
release: v$NEW_VERSION
```

Then push to remote:

```bash
git push
```

### 5. Update downstream projects

For each downstream project, update all `@haklex/*` dependency versions to `$NEW_VERSION`:

**Shiroi** — `<HOME>/git/repos/Shiroi/apps/web/package.json`

- Update `@haklex/rich-editor`, `@haklex/rich-kit-shiro`, `@haklex/rich-static-renderer`

**admin-vue3** — `<HOME>/git/repos/admin-vue3/package.json`

- Update `@haklex/rich-diff`, `@haklex/rich-ext-nested-doc`, `@haklex/rich-editor`, `@haklex/rich-editor-ui`, `@haklex/rich-kit-shiro`, `@haklex/rich-plugin-toolbar`, `@haklex/rich-style-token`

**mx-core** — `<HOME>/git/repos/mx-core/apps/core/package.json`

- Update `@haklex/rich-headless`

Use sed or Edit to replace pinned version strings. Match pattern: `"@haklex/<pkg>": "<old_version>"` → `"@haklex/<pkg>": "$NEW_VERSION"`.

### 6. Install in downstream projects

Run `pnpm install` in each downstream project root:

```bash
cd < HOME > /git/repos/Shiroi && pnpm install
cd < HOME > /git/repos/admin-vue3 && pnpm install
cd < HOME > /git/repos/mx-core && pnpm install
```

### 7. Check for new features to integrate

Compare the haklex git log since the previous version tag to identify new exports, new packages, or breaking changes:

```bash
cd < HOME > /git/repos/haklex && git log --oneline HEAD~20..HEAD
```

Scan for:

- New package exports (new entry points in `package.json` exports)
- New renderer/plugin/extension packages that downstream projects might want
- Breaking changes (renamed exports, removed APIs)

If new features are found, ask the user whether to integrate them into specific downstream projects. Do NOT auto-integrate without confirmation.

### 8. Commit and push in downstream projects

For each downstream project with changes, stage, commit, and push immediately:

```bash
# Shiroi
cd < HOME > /git/repos/Shiroi && git add -A && git commit -m "chore(deps): bump @haklex/* to $NEW_VERSION" && git push

# admin-vue3
cd < HOME > /git/repos/admin-vue3 && git add -A && git commit -m "chore(deps): bump @haklex/* to $NEW_VERSION" && git push

# mx-core
cd < HOME > /git/repos/mx-core && git add -A && git commit -m "chore(deps): bump @haklex/* to $NEW_VERSION" && git push
```

### 9. Summary

Print a table:

_**Agent - sidechain (claude-opus-4-6 2026-03-07 15:20:41Z)**_

demo 页面中 nested-doc 是 **editor** 侧的注册（`NestedDocPlugin`、`NestedDocDialogEditorProvider`），这是编辑器功能插件，和 renderer 端的节点注册不同。Editor 侧的 `NestedDocPlugin` 负责编辑交互（创建/编辑嵌套文档），这不能删除——它是 editor 独有的功能。

ShiroRenderer 接入的是 **static 渲染端**的 `nestedDocNodes`，两者职责不同。demo 的 editor 注册应当保留。
